2019 MINI Hardtop 4 Door Cooper Iconic Style with Extra PracticalityThe 2019 MINI Hardtop 4 Door Cooper is the perfect solution for those who love the classic British go-kart handling but need a bit more room for friends and gear. By adding two extra doors and extending the wheelbase, MINI has created a hatchback that retains its legendary personality while offering the everyday usability that a modern life demands.Under the hood, the Cooper is powered by a spirited 1.5-liter TwinPower Turbo 3-cylinder engine, delivering 134 horsepower and 162 lb-ft of torque. This punchy engine is paired with either a crisp 6-speed manual or a 6-speed Steptronic automatic transmission. Thanks to its lightweight frame and turbocharger, it feels zippy and responsive, capable of reaching 0 60 mph in a nimble 7.7 seconds.The driving experience is pure MINI. The wheels are pushed out to the corners, providing that signature low-slung, planted feel. The MacPherson strut front suspension and multi-link rear suspension work together to provide sharp, precise steering that makes every city corner feel like a lap on a track. While the ride is firm, it rewards the driver with unmatched agility and a visceral connection to the road.On the exterior, the 4-door model maintains the iconic circular headlights, Union Jack taillights (standard for 2019), and customizable roof and mirror cap colors. The extra doors are cleverly integrated into the design, and the frameless windows maintain the sleek, sporty profile that has made MINI an automotive icon for decades.Inside, the cabin is a mix of premium materials and quirky, circular design elements, offering:
  • 6.5-inch (or available 8.8-inch) center display with a customizable LED ring
  • Premium Carbon Black Sensatec or available Chesterfield Leather seating
  • Ambient lighting that changes color to match your driving mode
  • Leather-wrapped sport steering wheel and toggle-switch controls
Practicality is significantly improved over the 2-door model. The 4-door Cooper offers seating for five and provides much easier access to the rear seats. It features 13.1 cubic feet of cargo space behind the rear seats, which expands to approximately 40 cubic feet when the 60/40 split-folding rear seats are down plenty of room for a weekend's worth of luggage or a large grocery run.Fuel economy is a strong point for this turbocharged three-cylinder, averaging an impressive 28 MPG city/37 MPG highway. This makes it an exceptionally efficient choice for daily commuting without sacrificing the fun factor that defines the brand.Safety is robust, with the 2019 model featuring the Active Driving Assistant as standard. This suite includes Forward Collision Warning and Automatic Emergency Braking. Additionally, the ultra-rigid body frame and eight airbags ensure that all occupants are well-protected in the event of an impact.The 2019 MINI Hardtop 4 Door Cooper is the quintessential fun car that actually works for your daily life. It is the ideal choice for the driver who wants a car with a massive personality, sharp reflexes, and enough space to bring others along for the ride.Zippy. Iconic. Surprisingly Versatile. ??

A head-up display, panoramic sunroof, and heated windshield further enhance the driving experience.

Blending breathtaking performance with elite luxury and cutting-edge technology, this S 63 AMG stands as one of the most complete and desirable high-performance sedans ever built.

The 2025 BMW 7 Series 740i xDrive stands as a premier executive sedan, merging a commanding road presence with an exceptionally quiet and refined cabin. This flagship model utilizes a sophisticated forty-eight-volt mild-hybrid system to enhance power delivery and efficiency, providing a balanced and composed driving experience across both city streets and open highways.
Performance
This sedan is powered by a three-liter BMW Twin Power Turbo inline six-cylinder engine that generates three hundred seventy-five horsepower and three hundred ninety-eight pound-feet of torque. An eight-speed Sport Automatic transmission with paddle shifters and Launch Control manages the output, while the xDrive all-wheel-drive system ensures optimal traction. This combination allows the vehicle to accelerate from zero to sixty miles per hour in four point nine seconds. The standard two-axle self-leveling air suspension and Dynamic Damper Control work together to provide a smooth ride while maintaining sharp handling.
Design
The exterior design is highlighted by an upright profile and a unique split-headlight arrangement. The signature kidney grille features an available illuminated border, paired with flush-mounted door handles and twenty-inch M Aero wheels. The interior offers a luxurious environment with high-quality materials, including leather upholstery and glass controls. A Panoramic Sky Lounge LED roof adds a customizable ambient light effect throughout the cabin.
Technology
The interior technology is anchored by the BMW Curved Display, which integrates a twelve point three-inch digital instrument cluster and a fourteen point nine-inch central touchscreen. This setup runs the latest iDrive operating system and supports wireless smartphone integration and a premium Bowers & Wilkins Surround Sound system. Rear-seat passengers can enjoy an available thirty-one-inch Theater Screen with eight-K resolution and high-speed connectivity for on-the-go entertainment.
Advanced Safety Features
A comprehensive suite of safety technology includes frontal collision warning, active blind spot detection, and lane departure warning. The vehicle is also equipped with Parking Assistant Professional, a backup assistant, and a three-D-view camera system to assist in tight spaces. For enhanced protection, an active system monitors for potential collisions and automatically secures the cabin by tensioning seat belts and closing the windows and sunroof.
Convenience and Comfort
The cabin features four-zone automatic climate control and multi-contour heated seats for all passengers. Soft-close doors and a power tailgate offer ease of use, while keyless entry allows for quick access and ignition. For those focused on the rear-seat experience, the optional Executive Lounge seating provides reclining functions and a power-operated footrest for maximum relaxation. Or a vehicle runs a red light as you're approaching the intersection. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
